title: Gravestone of Eliza L. Singletary
caption: Gravestone of Eliza L. Singletary at Bell's Mill Creek Cemetery (now Bethel Creek Baptist Church Cemetery), Day, Lafayette County, Florida.
location: Bethel Creek Baptist Church Cemetery, Day, Lafayette County, Florida
description: Photograph of the gravestone of Eliza L. Singletary at Bethel Creek Baptist Church Cemetery, formerly Bell's Mill Creek Cemetery, in Day, Lafayette County, Florida. The inscription reads: 'ELIZA L. SINGLETARY / MOTHER OF / J. A. SINGLETARY / AT REST.' Family research identifies J. A. as Jacob A. Singletary, who is buried nearby with his wife, Ida Alla Miller. A Florida marriage record documents the marriage of Jacob A. Singletary and Ida Alla Miller on April 16, 1890, in Lafayette County. The gravestone contains no birth or death dates.

title: Gravestone of Reverend Jacob A. Singletary and Ally Ida Singletary

location: Bell's Mill Creek Cemetery (Bethel Creek Baptist Church Cemetery), Day, Lafayette County, Florida
description: The shared gravestone of Reverend Jacob A. Singletary and his wife, Ally Ida Singletary, records Jacob's birth as March 15, 1852, and his death as May 14, 1931. Ally Ida's inscription records her birth as May 28, 1873, and her death as October 16, 1945. The gravestone is located at Bell's Mill Creek Cemetery, also known as Bethel Creek Baptist Church Cemetery, in Day, Lafayette County, Florida. The date the photograph was taken has not been established.

title: George William Singletary with Woman, Possibly Nettie
caption: George William Singletary (1895–1964) seated beside an unidentified woman, possibly his second wife, Nettie. George is holding a pipe. The woman's identity has not been confirmed.
description: Historical family photograph showing George William Singletary seated in a wooden armchair beside a woman who may be his second wife, Nettie. George is wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers and is holding a smoking pipe. The woman is seated to his left, wearing a patterned dress with buttons down the front. Behind them is a round table covered with a fringed tablecloth. A wall calendar, window shutters, and a patterned floor covering are also visible. The date and location of the photograph are unknown. The identification of the woman as Nettie is based on family research and remains unconfirmed.

title: George William Singletary Seated in a Wooden Armchair
caption: George William Singletary (1895–1964) seated in a wooden armchair, possibly at his home. The date and location of the photograph are unknown.
description: Historical family photograph of George William Singletary seated alone in a wooden armchair. He is wearing a light-colored shirt and dark trousers, with his hands resting on his knees. A round table covered with a fringed tablecloth stands beside him, and a wall calendar, window shutters, and patterned floor covering are visible in the background. The furnishings closely match those in another photograph showing George seated beside an unidentified woman, suggesting that both photographs were taken in the same room and possibly on the same occasion. The date and location remain unknown.
